# CC01: 澹怀堂 Danhuai Tang

Wave 3 · Changchun Yuan · 3D: `/reconstruction/3d.html?b=CC01` · Page: `/scenes/#CC01` · Row: `research/buildings/CC01-danhuai-tang/`

## What it was

澹怀堂 Danhuai Tang, Changchun Yuan's audience hall inside the south gate (Malone's No.1): a five-bay gate with five-bay court rooms east and west, the main hall 澹怀堂 (also 勤政殿, for government and feasts of frontier princes), 众乐亭 behind, the open five-bay 云容水态 across the stream and 长桥 to the south-west (S05 j83:3a-3b; E0003, E0005, E0006). Finished 1747, repaired 1769 and 1791 (E0006). The gate quarter was dug in 2001, 2003 and 2004: about 21,000 m2, 220 by 90 m, 210 trenches and 24 building remains, the layout still that of the Qianlong founding, symmetrical from screen wall to 众乐亭 with a boat landing north of it (S316 snippet; E0007, E0336). The gate was rebuilt on its site and opened in October 2016 (E0008). Not among the buildings left standing after 1860 (E0451, after 刘敦桢), so it burned in October 1860 (S02 pp.187-188).

From the inventory row: **built** 乾隆十二年 1747 宫门 (S44); poem 1749 [j83:3b]; **destroyed** 1860 (S05, S44, S01).

### Open questions that name it

- **Q9. Bay counts, plan against text.** They agree at 廓然大公, 蓬岛瑶台, 别有洞天, 观澜堂, 宫门, 远瀛观, 方外观. They differ: 澹怀堂 5 (plan, excavation via S112) vs 9 (S06); 含经堂 about 9 vs 7 (S05) vs 5 (S06); 正谊明道 about 8 vs 5 (S05) vs 7 (S48); 长春仙馆 7 vs 5; 茹古涵今 6 vs 5; 九洲清晏殿 5 vs 7; 勤政殿 4 vs 5; 上下天光 9 cells vs 3; 保合太和 9×3 vs 3; 鱼跃鸢飞 6×5 vs 5;
- **Q14. A label names which hall?** The readers found a working rule: a label in a court names the hall north of it (同顺堂, 含经堂, 澹怀堂 ...). Where halls stand on both sides it is an assumption. Applies to many `likely` rows.
- **Q20. Name variants.** 九洲清晏 / 九州清晏 / 九州清宴; 蒨园 (S05) / 茜园 (S06); 麴院风荷 (S05) / 曲院风荷; 如园 (S05) / 茹园 (S06); 澹怀堂 / 淡怀堂; 黄花阵 / 万花阵 / 花园 / 黄花灯; 涵远斋 / 涵远楼; 含韵斋 / 含韵轩; 鱼跃鸢飞 / 鱼跃莺飞; 清夏斋 / 清夏堂; 湛清轩 / 湛清斋 / 湛静斋; 凌虚阁 (S06) / 凌虚亭 (S49, S01); 淳化轩 / 淳化閣. 澹泊宁静: S01's third character looks like 清.
